devdoc.title: FixedOrderSandNftSale A FixedOrderInventorySale contract implementation that handles the purchases of Sandbox NFTs track NFTs from a holder account to the recipient. The provisioning of the NFTs from the holder account occurs in a sequential order defined by a token list. Only a single SKU is supported.
